speakers.name: Mark Fuge
speakers.title: Machines that learn to design, build, and test other machines
speakers.bio: Mark Fuge is Professor of Artificial Intelligence in Engineering Design and director of the IDEAL Lab at ETH Zurich. His research develops learned geometry representations and generative design methods that incorporate physical performance and manufacturing constraints.

speakers.name: Kristina Shea
speakers.title: AI-Driven Engineering Design and Digital Fabrication
speakers.bio: Kristina Shea is Professor of Engineering Design and Computing at ETH Zurich. Her research connects design synthesis and optimization with additive manufacturing, multi-material fabrication, and 4D printing, including programmable structures and soft robotic mechanisms.

speakers.name: Sha Yi
speakers.title: Learning to Design Robots
speakers.bio: Sha Yi is a Member of Technical Staff at Physical Intelligence and an incoming Assistant Professor at New York University (2027). Her soft-gripper co-design work uses learned physics models to jointly optimize stiffness and grasp pose, connecting simulation, fabrication, and physical evaluation.

speakers.name: Ken Goldberg
speakers.title: Agentic Robotics: From Code Generation to Physical Execution
speakers.bio: Ken Goldberg is a Professor at the University of California, Berkeley, where he directs the AUTOLab, and Co-Founder and Chief Scientist of Ambi Robotics. His research spans manipulation, learning, and automation, including coding agents that combine engineering algorithms with learned perception and control.

speakers.name: Mohi Khansari
speakers.title: Embodied AI for Adaptive Manufacturing
speakers.bio: Mohi Khansari is Director of Embodied AI at the Stanford Robotics Center and a Senior Research Engineer in Computer Science, leading its Manufacturing and Logistics initiative. His expertise spans robot learning, world models, and autonomous-system reasoning. Previously, he was Head of Robot Learning at 1X.

speakers.name: Ted Xiao
speakers.title: Towards a Post-AGI Manufacturing Economy
speakers.bio: Ted Xiao is a Founding Member of Technical Staff at Prometheus. Previously, he was a Staff Research Scientist and Technical Lead at Google DeepMind. His foundation-model research addresses physical reasoning and interaction, with contributions including Gemini Robotics, RT-2, and SayCan.

speakers.name: Marta D’Elia
speakers.title: To be announced
speakers.bio: Marta D’Elia is Director of AI and ModSim at Atomic Machines and an Adjunct Professor at Stanford’s Institute for Computational and Mathematical Engineering. Her work brings scientific machine learning, optimization, generative design, and digital twins to micro-manufacturing.
